label: E-9: window to obtain permission for a new workplace
unit: months from the workplace change application
appliesTo: E-9 workers who have applied for a workplace change through the employment centre
why: The second of two consecutive deadlines, and the one whose consequence is departure rather than a refused application. It is measured from the application rather than from the day the job ended, so a worker who applies late has not bought extra searching time — they have shortened the total. Both clocks together are why a lost job on E-9 becomes an immigration problem in weeks, where a professional status gives months.

history.source: Act on the Employment of Foreign Workers, art. 25
history.note: Permission for the new workplace must be obtained within three months of applying for the change, failing which the worker must leave Korea. It follows a separate one-month deadline to make the application after the contract ends. Statutory exceptions including occupational injury, illness and pregnancy or childbirth can change how the periods are counted.
